description: A text input component with size variants and error state.

type.description: HTML input type (text, email, password, number, etc.)

name.description: Form field name. Required for the value to appear in FormData — without it the field submits nothing.

required.description: Marks the field required for native constraint validation.

readonly.description: Makes the field read-only while still submitting its value.

autocomplete.description: Forwarded to the inner input (e.g. email, current-password, one-time-code).

min.description: Minimum value for number and date-like inputs.

max.description: Maximum value for number and date-like inputs.

pattern.description: Regular expression the value must match.

inputmode.description: Hint for the virtual keyboard to display.

enterkeyhint.description: Hint for the virtual keyboard Enter key label.

spellcheck.description: Whether spelling and grammar checking is enabled.

multiple.description: Allows multiple values for supported input types.

list.description: Id of a datalist providing suggestions.

form.description: Id of an external form that owns the input.

aihio-input.description: Fired on every keystroke. The live value is available through detail and the value property; it is never copied into the value attribute.

aihio-change.description: Fired when the value is committed (blur or Enter)

value.description: Get or set the current value

defaultValue.description: Get or set the reset value reflected by the value attribute

control.description: The native input delegated to by the component

form.description: The owning form, or null outside one

willValidate.description: Whether the control participates in constraint validation

handled: The inner <input> inherits placeholder, type, disabled state, constraints, and the authored default value
The inner <input> is real light DOM, so name, required, readonly, autocomplete, and form ownership give native submission and validation

required.when: input has no visible <label> associated by for/id
required.requirement: Provide aria-label on aihio-input, or wrap in a <label>. Placeholder is not a label.
Describe the error via aria-describedby pointing to a visible message; the red border alone is not conveyed to screen readers.

required.when: the field is inside a <form> and its value should be submitted
required.requirement: Set name. A field without a name is omitted from FormData entirely.

counterExamples.reason: Placeholder is not a label. Associate a <label> or add aria-label.
error=true without an aria-describedby message leaves screen reader users without context.
No name attribute, so this field submits nothing. Add name="email".

examples: Password is too short.

checkValidity().description: Runs native constraint validation and returns whether the field is valid.

reportValidity().description: Runs native constraint validation and shows the browser message if invalid.

focus().description: Moves focus to the native input.
